notes.title: Game follow up update plan
notes.notes:
The content of the game will be updated over time


Gradually adjust the UI, interface, etc.

According to the feedback, some operations and game playing methods will be modified, and the difficulty and enemy parameters will be adjusted appropriately.

Continue to fix bugs that may exist in the game.

Add new features and maps.

The plot and worldview will be supplemented later.

notes.title: The game is on sale
notes.notes: Epidemic will be on sale at 10:00 on February 1.
